rationale: Artem's deep expertise in efficient inference, vision-language models, and ML systems directly complements Stiven's work on ArNav, Braillic's AR surgical navigation platform that relies on real-time computer vision and ML. As CTO seeking to expand engineering capacity, Stiven could benefit from Artem's hands-on experience optimizing transformers and VLM inference—critical for deploying AI in resource-constrained surgical environments.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Stiven Ding — Stiven is building real-time 3D surgical guidance with AR and computer vision at Braillic, and your work on efficient VLM inference and ML infrastructure could be directly relevant to the technical challenges he's solving.
